```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r compare-t-and-z}
yl <- 0.38
x <- seq(-6, 6, length=100)
y1 <- dnorm(x)
y2 <- dt(x, 10)
y3 <- dt(x, 4)

data.frame(x, y1, y2, y3) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x, y1) +
  geom_line(
    color="black",
    size=1) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y=y2), 
    color="darkgreen",
    size=1,
    linetype="51") +
  geom_line(
    aes(y=y3), 
    color="darkred",
    size=1,
    linetype="11") +
  geom_text(
    x=1.5, y=0.38, hjust=0, 
    label="Black solid line is the normal distribution") +
  geom_text(
    x=1.5, y=0.36, hjust=0,
    color="darkgreen",
    label="Dark green dashed line is the t with df=10") +
  geom_text(
    x=1.5, y=0.34, hjust=0,  
    color="darkred",
    label="Dark red dotted line is the t with df=4") +
  labs(caption="Steve Simon, 2024-10-06") -> plot01

plot01
ggsave("../images/plot01.png")
```

```{r t-with-4-df}
data.frame(x, y3) |>
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x, y3) +
  geom_polygon(fill="white", color="black") +
  expand_limits(x=c(-7, 7)) +
  labs(
    caption="Simon, 2024-10-06",
    x=" ",
    y=" ") -> t_4_curve
```

## P[t(4) < 1.5]

```{r prob-1}
a <- 1.5
t_4_curve +
  geom_vline(xintercept=a) +
  geom_label(x=a, y=yl, label=a) +
  geom_label(x=a-0.5, y=0, label="Area = ?") -> plot02

plot02
ggsave("../images/plot02.png")
```

## P[t(4) < -0.5]


## P[-2.5 < t(4) < 2.5]

```{r prob-5}
a <- 2.5
t_4_curve +
  geom_vline(xintercept=-a) +
  geom_vline(xintercept= a) +
  geom_label(x=-a, y=yl, label=-a) +
  geom_label(x= a, y=yl, label= a) +
  geom_label(x=0, y=0, label="Area = ?") -> plot06

plot06
ggsave("../images/plot06.png")
```

## 25th percentile of t(4)

```{r quantile-1}
p <- 0.25
a <- qt(p, 4)
t_4_curve +
  geom_vline(xintercept=a) +
  geom_label(x=a, y=yl, label="Quantile = ?") +
  geom_label(x=a-0.5, y=0, label=p) -> plot08

plot08
ggsave("../images/plot08.png")
```

## Critical values for area=1-alpha

```{r}
#| label: t-curve

x <- seq(-6, 6, length=100)
y <- dt(x, 4)

data.frame(x, y) |>
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) + 
  geom_line(
    color="black",
    size=1) +
  expand_limits(y=0.4) +
  expand_limits(x=c(-7, 7)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(from=-6, to=6, by=2)) +
  labs(
    caption="Simon, 2024-10-06",
    x=" ",
    y=" ") -> t_curve
```

```{r}
#| label: expressions

a <- qt(0.98, 4)
eq0 <- expression(paste("Area = 1 - ", alpha))
eq1 <- expression(paste("t(", alpha, "/2, df)"))
eq2 <- expression(paste("t(1-", alpha, "/2, df)"))
eq3 <- expression(paste("Area = ", alpha, "/2"))
```

```{r}
#| label: plot10
#| message: false
#| warning: false

t_curve +
  geom_segment(x=-a, y=0, xend=-a, yend=0.38) +
  geom_segment(x= a, y=0, xend= a, yend=0.38) +
  geom_label(x=0, y=0, label=eq0) +
  geom_label(x=-a, y=0.4, label=eq1) +
  geom_label(x= a, y=0.4, label=eq2) +
  geom_label(x=-a-1.4, y=0, label=eq3) +
  geom_label(x= a+1.4, y=0, label=eq3) -> plot10

plot10
ggsave("../images/plot10.png")
```
